CefSharp provides .NET bindings for the Chromium Embedded Framework for Windows Forms and Windows Presentation Foundation applications. Prior to version 148.0.90, CefSharp/SchemeHandler/FolderSchemeHandlerFactory.cs used filePath.StartsWith(rootFolder, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) to decide whether a decoded and canonicalized request path remained inside rootFolder. That raw prefix test did not enforce a directory boundary, so a request such as ..%2fwww2/secret.txt could escape a configured www directory into a sibling www2 directory whose path shared the same string prefix. Applications that register FolderSchemeHandlerFactory for a custom scheme or an HTTP or HTTPS scheme can therefore serve local files outside the intended root when an attacker can cause the embedded browser to request the crafted URL. The issue affects both Unix-style paths such as /tmp/app/www2 and Windows paths such as C:\app\www2, and the fix appends a directory separator to the normalized root before comparison while rejecting null bytes and alternate data stream syntax. This issue is fixed in version 148.0.90.

CefSharp proporciona enlaces .NET para el Chromium Embedded Framework para aplicaciones de Windows Forms y Windows Presentation Foundation. Antes de la versión 148.0.90, CefSharp/SchemeHandler/FolderSchemeHandlerFactory.cs utilizaba filePath.StartsWith(rootFolder, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) para decidir si una ruta de solicitud decodificada y canonizada permanecía dentro de rootFolder. Esa prueba de prefijo sin procesar no aplicaba un límite de directorio, por lo que una solicitud como ..%2fwww2/secret.txt podría escapar de un directorio www configurado a un directorio www2 hermano cuya ruta compartía el mismo prefijo de cadena. Las aplicaciones que registran FolderSchemeHandlerFactory para un esquema personalizado o un esquema HTTP o HTTPS pueden, por lo tanto, servir archivos locales fuera de la raíz prevista cuando un atacante puede hacer que el navegador incrustado solicite la URL manipulada. El problema afecta tanto a las rutas de estilo Unix como /tmp/app/www2 como a las rutas de Windows como C:\app\www2, y la solución añade un separador de directorio a la raíz normalizada antes de la comparación, al tiempo que rechaza los bytes nulos y la sintaxis de flujo de datos alternativo. Este problema se corrige en la versión 148.0.90.

linuxfabrik-lib provides Python modules for database access, caching, shell execution, and API integrations, and Linuxfabrik Monitoring Plugins uses its shared testing helper across check plugins. Prior to linuxfabrik-lib 6.1.0 and Linuxfabrik Monitoring Plugins 7.0.0, lib.lftest.test() treated the first or second element of a --test CSV argument as a filesystem path and returned the file contents as simulated standard output or standard error without path confinement. The hidden but production-accessible --test argument was accepted by sudo-authorized plugins, so an attacker controlling the nagios or icinga account could use check-plugins/deb-updates/deb-updates with its default QUERY=1 to disclose every line of a root-readable file. Approximately 22 other plugins exposed filtered content or a root file existence and readability oracle through the same helper, while check-plugins/network-bonding/network-bonding and check-plugins/openstack-swift-stat/openstack-swift-stat had direct read paths that bypassed the helper. The library fix confines fixture reads to the invoking plugin's unit-test directory and refuses unsafe anchors, and the plugin fix routes the two bypasses through that helper. These issues are fixed in linuxfabrik-lib 6.1.0 and Linuxfabrik Monitoring Plugins 7.0.0.

linuxfabrik-lib proporciona módulos Python para acceso a bases de datos, almacenamiento en caché, ejecución de shell e integraciones de API, y Linuxfabrik Monitoring Plugins utiliza su ayudante de pruebas compartido en todos los plugins de verificación. Antes de linuxfabrik-lib 6.1.0 y Linuxfabrik Monitoring Plugins 7.0.0, lib.lftest.test() trataba el primer o segundo elemento de un argumento CSV --test como una ruta del sistema de archivos y devolvía el contenido del archivo como salida estándar simulada o error estándar sin confinamiento de ruta. El argumento --test oculto pero accesible en producción era aceptado por plugins autorizados por sudo, por lo que un atacante que controlara la cuenta nagios o icinga podría usar check-plugins/deb-updates/deb-updates con su QUERY=1 predeterminado para divulgar cada línea de un archivo legible por root. Aproximadamente otros 22 plugins exponían contenido filtrado o un oráculo de existencia y legibilidad de archivos root a través del mismo ayudante, mientras que check-plugins/network-bonding/network-bonding y check-plugins/openstack-swift-stat/openstack-swift-stat tenían rutas de lectura directas que eludían al ayudante. La corrección de la biblioteca confina las lecturas de fixtures al directorio de pruebas unitarias del plugin invocador y rechaza anclajes inseguros, y la corrección del plugin enruta los dos desvíos a través de ese ayudante. Estos problemas están solucionados en linuxfabrik-lib 6.1.0 y Linuxfabrik Monitoring Plugins 7.0.0.

A vulnerability has been found in BusyBox up to 1.30.1. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file networking/wget.c of the component FEATURE_WGET_TIMEOUT Handler. Such manipulation of the argument -T leads to null pointer dereference. Local access is required to approach this attack. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The name of the patch is 83a40bf7a93c8ac093d33ab452222dd5b9eb57ff. A patch should be applied to remediate this issue.

Una vulnerabilidad ha sido encontrada en BusyBox hasta 1.30.1. Esta vulnerabilidad afecta código desconocido del archivo networking/wget.c del componente FEATURE_WGET_TIMEOUT Gestor. Tal manipulación del argumento -T lleva a desreferencia de puntero nulo. Acceso local es requerido para abordar este ataque. El exploit ha sido divulgado al público y puede ser usado. El nombre del parche es 83a40bf7a93c8ac093d33ab452222dd5b9eb57ff. Un parche debería ser aplicado para remediar este problema.
A cross-site scripting vulnerability exists in acmailer, which may allow an attacker to execute an arbitrary script.
Existe una vulnerabilidad de cross-site scripting en acmailer, lo que podría permitir a un atacante ejecutar un script arbitrario.
An incorrect authorization vulnerability exists in acmailer, which may allow a user to create a sub-account that has administrative privileges.
Existe una vulnerabilidad de autorización incorrecta en acmailer, lo que puede permitir a un usuario crear una subcuenta que tiene privilegios administrativos.

The Product Shortlist WordPress plugin through 1.0.4 does not properly sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform SQL injection attacks.

El plugin de WordPress Product Shortlist hasta la versión 1.0.4 no sanitiza ni escapa correctamente un parámetro antes de usarlo en una sentencia SQL, lo que permite a atacantes no autenticados realizar ataques de inyección SQL.

The SmartCrawl SEO checker, analyzer & optimizer WordPress plugin before 3.16.3 does not perform capability checks on two of its AJAX actions, allowing users with at least the Subscriber role to read the titles of private and draft posts by ID and to enumerate stored post-meta key names.

El plugin de WordPress SmartCrawl SEO checker, analyzer & optimizer anterior a la versión 3.16.3 no realiza comprobaciones de capacidad en dos de sus acciones AJAX, lo que permite a usuarios con al menos el rol de Suscriptor leer los títulos de entradas privadas y borradores por ID y enumerar los nombres de las claves de metadatos de entradas almacenadas.

The Animation Addons for Elementor  WordPress plugin before 2.7.2 does not validate a user-supplied value before using it to build the host of a server-side HTTP request, allowing unauthenticated users to make the site issue requests to internal hosts and read the responses back.

El plugin de WordPress Animation Addons for Elementor anterior a la versión 2.7.2 no valida un valor proporcionado por el usuario antes de usarlo para construir el host de una solicitud HTTP del lado del servidor, lo que permite a usuarios no autenticados hacer que el sitio emita solicitudes a hosts internos y leer las respuestas.

The TabaPay Gateway WordPress plugin through 1.4.0 does not validate the payment callback before establishing a session for the account associated with the referenced order, allowing unauthenticated attackers to log in as any registered user, including an administrator.

El plugin de WordPress TabaPay Gateway hasta la versión 1.4.0 no valida la devolución de llamada de pago antes de establecer una sesión para la cuenta asociada con el pedido referenciado, permitiendo a atacantes no autenticados iniciar sesión como cualquier usuario registrado, incluido un administrador.

The W3 Total Cache WordPress plugin before 2.10.5 does not properly validate the request path it uses to build cache file names, allowing unauthenticated attackers to write a file into any existing directory on the server, inside or outside the web root, overwriting whatever occupies the target name.
On Apache, the same flaw overwrites the site's .htaccess files, which breaks the site and can strip hardening rules that other security measures rely on.

El plugin de WordPress W3 Total Cache anterior a la versión 2.10.5 no valida correctamente la ruta de la solicitud que utiliza para construir nombres de archivos de caché, permitiendo a atacantes no autenticados escribir un archivo en cualquier directorio existente en el servidor, dentro o fuera de la raíz web, sobrescribiendo lo que ocupe el nombre de destino.
En Apache, el mismo fallo sobrescribe los archivos .[htaccess] del sitio, lo que rompe el sitio y puede eliminar reglas de endurecimiento en las que se basan otras medidas de seguridad.

The WP Directory Kit WordPress plugin before 1.5.7 does not perform any authorization check on one of its public AJAX actions and returns unfiltered database rows, allowing unauthenticated attackers to retrieve the usernames and email addresses of users holding the WP Directory Kit WordPress plugin before 1.5.7's own roles.

El plugin de WordPress WP Directory Kit anterior a 1.5.7 no realiza ninguna comprobación de autorización en una de sus acciones AJAX públicas y devuelve filas de base de datos sin filtrar, permitiendo a atacantes no autenticados recuperar los nombres de usuario y las direcciones de correo electrónico de los usuarios que poseen los roles propios del plugin de WordPress WP Directory Kit anterior a 1.5.7.

The WP Maps  WordPress plugin before 4.9.8 does not perform a capability check, nor validate a nonce, in one of its AJAX actions, allowing users with a Subscriber account to create an unlimited number of options in the database, each of which is loaded on every page request.

El plugin de WordPress WP Maps anterior a la versión 4.9.8 no realiza una comprobación de capacidad, ni valida un nonce, en una de sus acciones AJAX, permitiendo a los usuarios con una cuenta de Suscriptor crear un número ilimitado de opciones en la base de datos, cada una de las cuales se carga en cada solicitud de página.

The TrueBooker  WordPress plugin before 1.2.7 does not have proper authorisation checks in some of its AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to change the email address of arbitrary users, including administrators, and subsequently take over their account via the password reset flow.

El plugin de WordPress TrueBooker anterior a la versión 1.2.7 no tiene comprobaciones de autorización adecuadas en algunas de sus acciones AJAX, lo que permite a usuarios no autenticados cambiar la dirección de correo electrónico de usuarios arbitrarios, incluyendo administradores, y posteriormente tomar el control de su cuenta a través del flujo de restablecimiento de contraseña.

The TrueBooker  WordPress plugin before 1.2.7 does not have proper authorisation checks in one of its AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to change the status of arbitrary appointments, as well as to trigger notification emails to the affected customers.

El plugin de WordPress TrueBooker anterior a la versión 1.2.7 no tiene comprobaciones de autorización adecuadas en una de sus acciones AJAX, permitiendo a usuarios no autenticados cambiar el estado de citas arbitrarias, así como activar correos electrónicos de notificación a los clientes afectados.

The TrueBooker  WordPress plugin before 1.2.7 does not have proper authorisation checks in some of its AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve the personal information of customers who booked an appointment, including their name, email address, phone number and postal address.

El plugin de WordPress TrueBooker anterior a la versión 1.2.7 no tiene comprobaciones de autorización adecuadas en algunas de sus acciones AJAX, permitiendo a usuarios no autenticados recuperar la información personal de los clientes que reservaron una cita, incluyendo su nombre, dirección de correo electrónico, número de teléfono y dirección postal.

The TrueBooker  WordPress plugin before 1.2.7 does not have proper authorisation checks in one of its AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to delete arbitrary appointment records along with their associated booking items and payment records.

El plugin de WordPress TrueBooker anterior a la versión 1.2.7 no tiene comprobaciones de autorización adecuadas en una de sus acciones AJAX, lo que permite a usuarios no autenticados eliminar registros de citas arbitrarios junto con sus elementos de reserva y registros de pago asociados.

The Broken Link Checker WordPress plugin before 2.4.12 does not limit which query variables it accepts from user input on sites using plain permalinks, allowing unauthenticated users to overwrite arbitrary PHP global variables, and to execute arbitrary code on the server when a classic (non-block)  is active.

El plugin de WordPress Broken Link Checker anterior a la versión 2.4.12 no limita qué variables de consulta acepta de la entrada del usuario en sitios que utilizan permalinks planos, lo que permite a usuarios no autenticados sobrescribir variables globales de PHP arbitrarias y ejecutar código arbitrario en el servidor cuando un clásico (no de bloque) está activo.

The KiviCare  WordPress plugin before 4.5.4 does not verify that the requesting user owns the appointment being modified, allowing authenticated patient-level users to cancel and reschedule other patients' appointments.

El plugin de WordPress KiviCare anterior a la versión 4.5.4 no verifica que el usuario solicitante sea el propietario de la cita que se está modificando, lo que permite a usuarios autenticados con nivel de paciente cancelar y reprogramar citas de otros pacientes.

The KiviCare  WordPress plugin before 4.5.4 does not verify that the requesting user is entitled to the media file being served, allowing authenticated patient-level users to download any file in the media library, including other patients' uploaded medical reports.

El plugin de WordPress KiviCare anterior a 4.5.4 no verifica que el usuario solicitante tenga derecho al archivo multimedia que se está sirviendo, lo que permite a los usuarios autenticados con nivel de paciente descargar cualquier archivo de la biblioteca de medios, incluidos los informes médicos subidos por otros pacientes.

The WPS Bidouille WordPress plugin before 1.33.5 does not have proper authorisation checks in an AJAX action, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to retrieve the email addresses of all registered users.

El plugin de WordPress WPS Bidouille anterior a la versión 1.33.5 no tiene comprobaciones de autorización adecuadas en una acción AJAX, lo que permite a cualquier usuario autenticado, como un suscriptor, recuperar las direcciones de correo electrónico de todos los usuarios registrados.

The SAML Single Sign On  WordPress plugin before 5.4.7 does not verify the signature of a SAML response before storing the certificate it carries, and offers an administrator a one-click control that promotes that stored certificate to the site's trusted signing certificate, allowing unauthenticated attackers to have a certificate of their own trusted and then authenticate as any user, including an administrator.

El plugin de WordPress SAML Single Sign On anterior a la versión 5.4.7 no verifica la firma de una respuesta SAML antes de almacenar el certificado que contiene, y ofrece a un administrador un control de un solo clic que promueve ese certificado almacenado al certificado de firma de confianza del sitio, permitiendo a atacantes no autenticados que un certificado propio sea de confianza y luego autenticarse como cualquier usuario, incluyendo un administrador.

The RTSP handler in libalias rewrote outgoing packets into a fixed-length stack buffer without checking whether the rewritten data fit in the buffer, or whether the result fit back in the original packet.

A host sending crafted RTSP traffic from inside a NAT gateway using libalias can overflow a stack buffer, potentially achieving remote code execution in the kernel (when using ipfw(4) NAT) or in the natd(8) process (which generally runs as the root user).

El gestor RTSP en libalias reescribía los paquetes salientes en un búfer de pila de longitud fija sin comprobar si los datos reescritos cabían en el búfer, o si el resultado cabía de nuevo en el paquete original.

Un host que envía tráfico RTSP manipulado desde el interior de una pasarela NAT que utiliza libalias puede desbordar un búfer de pila, logrando potencialmente ejecución remota de código en el kernel (cuando se utiliza ipfw(4) NAT) o en el proceso natd(8) (que generalmente se ejecuta como el usuario root).

The kernel function that implements unlinkat(2) and funlinkat(2) validated the AT_RESOLVE_BENEATH flag but failed to pass it through to the underlying path lookup.  The flag was silently dropped, so path resolution was not actually restricted.

A process that uses AT_RESOLVE_BENEATH with unlinkat(2) or funlinkat(2) to confine path resolution can in fact resolve paths above the starting directory.  A caller relying on this flag for path containment may delete files outside the intended directory tree.

La función del kernel que implementa unlinkat(2) y funlinkat(2) validó la bandera AT_RESOLVE_BENEATH pero no logró pasarla a la búsqueda de ruta subyacente. La bandera fue descartada silenciosamente, por lo que la resolución de ruta no estaba realmente restringida.

Un proceso que utiliza AT_RESOLVE_BENEATH con unlinkat(2) o funlinkat(2) para confinar la resolución de ruta puede de hecho resolver rutas por encima del directorio de inicio. Un llamador que confía en esta bandera para la contención de rutas puede eliminar archivos fuera del árbol de directorios previsto.

The RACK setsockopt(2) handler drops the connection lock in order to copy option data from userspace, then reacquires the lock.  After reacquiring, it verifies that the TCP stack had not been switched away, but did not reload its pointer to the stack's per-connection control block.  If userspace switches stacks twice during this window, the check will succeed but the saved pointer will refer to freed memory.

The bug may be exploitable by an unprivileged local user to escalate privileges.

El gestor RACK setsockopt(2) libera el bloqueo de conexión para copiar datos de opción desde el espacio de usuario, luego vuelve a adquirir el bloqueo. Después de volver a adquirirlo, verifica que la pila TCP no se había cambiado, pero no recargó su puntero al bloque de control por conexión de la pila. Si el espacio de usuario cambia de pila dos veces durante esta ventana, la verificación tendrá éxito pero el puntero guardado hará referencia a memoria liberada.

El error puede ser explotable por un usuario local no privilegiado para escalar privilegios.

When auditing a system call executed via ptrace(PT_SC_REMOTE), the kernel passed the return value of an internal setup function to AUDIT_SYSCALL_EXIT() rather than the actual result of the executed system call.  As a result, committed audit records for system calls which returned an error do not reflect the true outcome of the operation.  That is, they indicate that the operation succeeded when it in fact failed.

Audit records for system calls executed via ptrace(PT_SC_REMOTE) may show an incorrect error status.  An attacker with the ability to debug a process could use this to produce misleading audit trails, potentially undermining audit-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS).

Al auditar una llamada al sistema ejecutada a través de ptrace(PT_SC_REMOTE), el kernel pasó el valor de retorno de una función de configuración interna a AUDIT_SYSCALL_EXIT() en lugar del resultado real de la llamada al sistema ejecutada. Como resultado, los registros de auditoría confirmados para las llamadas al sistema que devolvieron un error no reflejan el verdadero resultado de la operación. Es decir, indican que la operación tuvo éxito cuando en realidad falló.

Los registros de auditoría para las llamadas al sistema ejecutadas a través de ptrace(PT_SC_REMOTE) pueden mostrar un estado de error incorrecto. Un atacante con la capacidad de depurar un proceso podría usar esto para producir rastros de auditoría engañosos, socavando potencialmente los Sistemas de Detección de Intrusiones (IDS) basados en auditorías.

Pages belonging to largepage shared memory objects were not explicitly wired.  When sendfile(2) transmitted such an object with the SF_NOCACHE flag, it freed the underlying pages after transmission even though existing mappings still referred to them.

An unprivileged local user can abuse the bug to access freed kernel memory.  This can be exploited to escalate privileges.

Páginas pertenecientes a objetos de memoria compartida de páginas grandes no estaban cableadas explícitamente. Cuando sendfile(2) transmitía dicho objeto con la bandera SF_NOCACHE, liberaba las páginas subyacentes después de la transmisión aunque las asignaciones existentes aún se referían a ellas.

Un usuario local sin privilegios puede abusar del error para acceder a memoria del kernel liberada. Esto puede ser explotado para escalar privilegios.

Certain system calls, such open(2) with the O_TRUNC flag set, and fspacectl(2), could incorrectly free memory in largepage objects.  These operations are not permitted on largepage objects, but the implementation did not verify this.

An unprivileged local user can abuse the bug to access freed kernel memory.  This can be exploited to escalate privileges.

Ciertas llamadas al sistema, como open(2) con el indicador O_TRUNC establecido, y fspacectl(2), podrían liberar memoria incorrectamente en objetos de página grande. Estas operaciones no están permitidas en objetos de página grande, pero la implementación no verificó esto.

Un usuario local sin privilegios puede abusar del error para acceder a memoria del kernel liberada. Esto puede ser explotado para escalar privilegios.

The ZFS_IOC_USERSPACE_MANY ioctl, used by zfs-userspace(8), truncated a 64-bit output buffer size to a 32-bit integer for the kernel allocation, but used the original 64-bit size as the buffer limit when writing records.

A local user with the "userused" delegated ZFS permission can trigger a kernel heap overflow via the ZFS_IOC_USERSPACE_MANY ioctl, potentially escalating privileges.

El ioctl ZFS_IOC_USERSPACE_MANY, utilizado por zfs-userspace(8), truncó un tamaño de búfer de salida de 64 bits a un entero de 32 bits para la asignación del kernel, pero usó el tamaño original de 64 bits como límite del búfer al escribir registros.

Un usuario local con el permiso ZFS delegado ’userused’ puede desencadenar un desbordamiento de montículo del kernel a través del ioctl ZFS_IOC_USERSPACE_MANY, escalando privilegios potencialmente.

The ZFS_IOC_RECV_NEW ioctl, in the heal receive path, similarly truncated a 64-bit payload size to a 32-bit integer for allocation, then used the original 64-bit size as the length for a byteswap operation.

A local user with the "receive" delegated ZFS permission can trigger kernel memory corruption via ZFS_IOC_RECV_NEW by sending a crafted receive stream in heal mode.

El ioctl ZFS_IOC_RECV_NEW, en la ruta de recepción de recuperación, truncó de manera similar un tamaño de carga útil de 64 bits a un entero de 32 bits para la asignación, y luego usó el tamaño original de 64 bits como la longitud para una operación de intercambio de bytes.

Un usuario local con el permiso ZFS delegado ’receive’ puede desencadenar corrupción de memoria del kernel a través de ZFS_IOC_RECV_NEW enviando un flujo de recepción manipulado en modo de recuperación.

The ZFS_IOC_SET_PROP ioctl, used by zfs-set(8), incorrectly validated the calling user such that an unprivileged user is able to set metadata on a dataset indicating that the dataset has received properties from a zfs-recv(8) stream.

Any local user can set the internal ZFS metadata flag "$hasrecvd" on datasets via ZFS_IOC_SET_PROP.

El ioctl ZFS_IOC_SET_PROP, utilizado por zfs-set(8), validó incorrectamente al usuario que realizaba la llamada, de tal manera que un usuario sin privilegios puede establecer metadatos en un conjunto de datos indicando que el conjunto de datos ha recibido propiedades de un flujo zfs-recv(8).

Cualquier usuario local puede establecer la bandera de metadatos interna de ZFS ’$hasrecvd’ en conjuntos de datos a través de ZFS_IOC_SET_PROP.
On ARM platforms, a vulnerability in the architecture design of HDD Password could allow an attacker to retrieve HDD Password from UEFI variables.
En plataformas ARM, una vulnerabilidad en el diseño de la arquitectura de la Contraseña del HDD podría permitir a un atacante recuperar la Contraseña del HDD de las variables UEFI.

The EWWW Image Optimizer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'data-script' Lazy Load Attribute in Post Content in all versions up to, and including, 8.7.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit is achieved by embedding a crafted img element with class='lazyload' and a data-script attribute pointing to an attacker-controlled URL in post content, which the plugin's bundled lazysizes ls.unveilhooks addon then uses to dynamically create and insert a script element into the DOM at page view time.

El plugin EWWW Image Optimizer para WordPress es vulnerable a cross-site scripting almacenado a través del atributo de carga diferida ’data-script’ en el contenido de las publicaciones en todas las versiones hasta la 8.7.3, inclusive, debido a la sanitización insuficiente de las entradas y al escape de las salidas. Esto hace posible que atacantes autenticados, con acceso de nivel de colaborador o superior, inyecten scripts web arbitrarios en páginas que se ejecutarán cada vez que un usuario acceda a una página inyectada. El exploit se logra incrustando un elemento img manipulado con class=’lazyload’ y un atributo data-script que apunta a una URL controlada por el atacante en el contenido de la publicación, que el complemento lazysizes ls.unveilhooks incluido en el plugin utiliza para crear e insertar dinámicamente un elemento script en el DOM en el momento de la visualización de la página.

The WP Statistics – Simple, privacy-friendly Google Analytics alternative plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'utm_campaign' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 14.16.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload can be planted without authentication via the public /wp-statistics/v2/hit REST endpoint, because the required signature is exposed on the public homepage and a base64-encoded page_uri POST parameter overrides the previously sanitized REQUEST_URI, allowing the malicious utm_campaign value to bypass sanitization and be stored in the database.

El plugin WP Statistics - Alternativa a Google Analytics simple y respetuosa con la privacidad para WordPress es vulnerable a Cross-Site Scripting Almacenado a través del parámetro ’utm_campaign’ en todas las versiones hasta la 14.16.8, inclusive, debido a una sanitización de entrada y escape de salida insuficientes. Esto hace posible que atacantes no autenticados inyecten scripts web arbitrarios en páginas que se ejecutarán cada vez que un usuario acceda a una página inyectada. La carga útil puede ser plantada sin autenticación a través del endpoint REST público /wp-statistics/v2/hit, porque la firma requerida está expuesta en la página de inicio pública y un parámetro POST page_uri codificado en base64 anula el REQUEST_URI previamente sanitizado, permitiendo que el valor malicioso de utm_campaign omita la sanitización y sea almacenado en la base de datos.

affectedData.product: WP Statistics – Simple, privacy-friendly Google Analytics alternative

When building the iovec array for a received TLS 1.2 CBC record, ktls_ocf_tls_cbc_decrypt() incremented the iovec index for every mbuf in the chain, including mbufs that were skipped because they contained only TLS header bytes.  This left uninitialized entries in the iovec array.  The iovec array was allocated without zeroing.

A remote TLS peer can cause the kernel to read from uninitialized iovec entries during HMAC computation, resulting in a kernel panic.  The peer must be able to control TCP segmentation such that the first mbuf of a CBC record contains only the 5-byte TLS record header.

Al construir el array iovec para un registro TLS 1.2 CBC recibido, ktls_ocf_tls_cbc_decrypt() incrementaba el índice iovec por cada mbuf en la cadena, incluyendo mbufs que fueron omitidos porque contenían solo bytes de cabecera TLS. Esto dejaba entradas no inicializadas en el array iovec. El array iovec fue asignado sin inicializar a cero.

Un par TLS remoto puede hacer que el kernel lea de entradas iovec no inicializadas durante el cálculo de HMAC, resultando en un pánico del kernel. El par debe ser capaz de controlar la segmentación TCP de tal manera que el primer mbuf de un registro CBC contenga solo la cabecera de registro TLS de 5 bytes.

The TranslatePress – Translate Multilingual sites with AI Translation plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting in versions up to and including 3.2.5. The special gettext markers '#!trpst#' and '#!trpen#' are unconditionally rewritten to '<' and '>' by translate_page() in includes/class-translation-render.php (lines 538-539). Because those markers are plain text with no HTML-special characters, an unauthenticated attacker can embed them in a comment; the markers survive wp_kses, and when the post is viewed in a secondary language the substitution turns the attacker's '#!trpst#img ... #!trpen#' into a real tag. remove_tags_from_output() only strips

El plugin TranslatePress - Translate Multilingual sites with AI Translation para WordPress es vulnerable a cross-site scripting almacenado no autenticado en versiones hasta la 3.2.5 inclusive. Los marcadores especiales de gettext ’#!trpst#’ y ’#!trpen#’ son reescritos incondicionalmente a ’<’ y ’>’ por translate_page() en includes/class-translation-render.php (líneas 538-539). Debido a que esos marcadores son texto plano sin caracteres especiales HTML, un atacante no autenticado puede incrustarlos en un comentario; los marcadores sobreviven a wp_kses, y cuando la publicación se ve en un idioma secundario la sustitución convierte el ’#!trpst#img ... #!trpen#’ del atacante en una etiqueta [img] real. remove_tags_from_output() solo elimina [script_tag]/[style], por lo que un se ejecuta en el navegador del visitante.

affectedData.product: TranslatePress – Translate Multilingual sites with AI Translation

descriptions.value: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability was found in swtpm's SWTPM_NVRAM_CheckHeader() function. The entry guard checks the buffer length against sizeof(bh), where bh is a pointer, instead of sizeof(*bh), the actual struct size. This allows an undersized buffer to pass validation, causing a 2-byte heap overread on 64-bit systems (6 bytes on 32-bit) when accessing the totlen field. This may cause daemon termination on some platforms and leaks heap data to the log.

Una vulnerabilidad de lectura fuera de límites se encontró en la función SWTPM_NVRAM_CheckHeader() de swtpm. El guardia de entrada comprueba la longitud del búfer contra sizeof(bh), donde bh es un puntero, en lugar de sizeof(bh), el tamaño real de la estructura. Esto permite que un búfer de tamaño insuficiente pase la validación, causando una sobrelectura de heap de 2 bytes en sistemas de 64 bits (6 bytes en 32 bits) al acceder al campo totlen. Esto puede causar la terminación del demonio en algunas plataformas y filtra datos del heap al registro.

A flaw was found in mod_cluster's AdvertiseListenerImpl (org.jboss.modcluster core module). A single crafted UDP multicast datagram with a valid HTTP status line and a "Server:" header but without the "Date:", "Digest:", and "Sequence:" headers triggers a NullPointerException in verifyDigest() that is not caught by the worker thread's exception handler. This causes the advertise listener thread to terminate permanently. The failure is silent (isListening() continues to return true) and persists until the node is restarted. The crash occurs before the AdvertiseSecurityKey comparison, so deployments with a configured security key are still affected.

Se encontró una vulnerabilidad en el AdvertiseListenerImpl de mod_cluster (módulo central org.jboss.modcluster). Un único datagrama multicast UDP manipulado con una línea de estado HTTP válida y una cabecera ’Server:’ pero sin las cabeceras ’Date:’, ’Digest:’ y ’Sequence:’ desencadena una NullPointerException en verifyDigest() que no es capturada por el gestor de excepciones del hilo de trabajo. Esto provoca que el hilo del oyente de anuncios termine permanentemente. El fallo es silencioso (isListening() continúa devolviendo true) y persiste hasta que se reinicia el nodo. El bloqueo ocurre antes de la comparación de AdvertiseSecurityKey, por lo que las implementaciones con una clave de seguridad configurada siguen estando afectadas.

A memory leak flaw was found in cockpit-ws. The login page handler leaks a heap allocation on every unauthenticated request that carries a CockpitLang cookie, allowing a remote unauthenticated attacker to exhaust memory on the host and cause a denial of service.

Se encontró un defecto de fuga de memoria en cockpit-ws. El gestor de la página de inicio de sesión fuga una asignación de pila en cada solicitud no autenticada que lleva una cookie CockpitLang, permitiendo a un atacante remoto no autenticado agotar la memoria en el host y causar una denegación de servicio.

The Ingenic T41, and probably also T32, T40, and A1 SoC boot ROMs parse and execute an attacker-controlled init table from the SPL header before checking the secure boot state and before invoking signature verification. The init table parser supports full-address 32-bit write operations, allowing modification of SRAM-resident secure boot state prior to the verification decision. An attacker with physical write access to boot media can inject an init-table entry that disables the secure boot check, causing the ROM to accept unsigned or modified first-stage boot code. This has been hardware-validated on a secureboot-enabled T41 device; ROM analysis confirms closely related behavior on T32, T40, and A1.

Las ROM de arranque de los SoC Ingenic T41, y probablemente también T32, T40 y A1, analizan y ejecutan una tabla init controlada por el atacante desde el encabezado SPL antes de verificar el estado de arranque seguro y antes de invocar la verificación de firma. El analizador de la tabla init admite operaciones de escritura de 32 bits de dirección completa, lo que permite la modificación del estado de arranque seguro residente en la SRAM antes de la decisión de verificación. Un atacante con acceso físico de escritura al medio de arranque puede inyectar una entrada en la tabla init que deshabilita la verificación de arranque seguro, haciendo que la ROM acepte código de arranque de primera etapa sin firmar o modificado. Esto ha sido validado por hardware en un dispositivo T41 con arranque seguro habilitado; el análisis de la ROM confirma un comportamiento estrechamente relacionado en T32, T40 y A1.

The Ingenic T31 SoC boot ROM flash-boot verification path compares only a single 32-bit word of the RSA signature output against a single 32-bit word of the SHA-256 payload digest, rather than compare the full data. This allows an attacker with physical write access to boot media to forge modified SPL (Secondary Program Loader) images that pass secure boot verification without possession of the OEM signing key. Each forgery attempt succeeds with approximately 2/3 probability. This has been validated via reverse engineering, software emulation against vendor-signed images, and end-to-end hardware acceptance of a forged firmware image on a Wyze Video Doorbell v2 (T31X).

La ruta de verificación de arranque flash de la ROM de arranque del SoC Ingenic T31 compara solo una palabra de 32 bits de la salida de la firma RSA contra una palabra de 32 bits del resumen de carga útil SHA-256, en lugar de comparar los datos completos. Esto permite a un atacante con acceso físico de escritura a los medios de arranque falsificar imágenes SPL (Secondary Program Loader) modificadas que pasan la verificación de arranque seguro sin posesión de la clave de firma del OEM. Cada intento de falsificación tiene éxito con aproximadamente 2/3 de probabilidad. Esto ha sido validado mediante ingeniería inversa, emulación de software contra imágenes firmadas por el proveedor y aceptación de hardware de extremo a extremo de una imagen de firmware falsificada en un Wyze Video Doorbell v2 (T31X).

IBM WebSphere Application Server 8.5 and 9.0, and IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.8 are vulnerable to HTTP request smuggling.

A flaw was found in `cockpit-ws`. This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by sending a specially crafted request. When the `WebService.UrlRoot` is configured and a request is made to the exact URL-root prefix without a trailing slash, `cockpit-ws` can terminate unexpectedly. This issue leads to the unavailability of the Cockpit web service.

A flaw was found in Cockpit. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability by initiating and sustaining numerous simultaneous connections to the `cockpit-tls` service. This forces the service to create an unbounded number of detached threads, consuming system resources such as memory and file descriptors. The primary consequence is a denial of service (DoS), leading to degradation or complete unavailability of the Cockpit service for legitimate users.
IBM i 7.6, 7.5, 7.4, and 7.3 could allow a local attacker to cause a denial of service due to improper validation of FTP authentication commands.
IBM i 7.6, 7.5, 7.4, and 7.3 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security restrictions and access internal network services due to improper validation of FTP PORT and EPRT commands.

A code injection vulnerability has been discovered in the Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2) 'ros2topic' command-line tool, affecting all ROS 2 distributions from Crystal Clemmys up to and including Lyrical Luth and Rolling Ridley. The vulnerability lies in the 'hz' verb, which reports the publishing rate of a topic and accepts a user-provided Python expression via the --filter option. This input is passed directly to the eval() function without sanitization, allowing a local user to craft and execute arbitrary code.

Se ha descubierto una vulnerabilidad de inyección de código en el Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2) herramienta de línea de comandos ’ros2topic’, que afecta a todas las distribuciones de ROS 2 desde Crystal Clemmys hasta Lyrical Luth y Rolling Ridley inclusive. La vulnerabilidad se encuentra en el verbo ’hz’, que informa la tasa de publicación de un tópico y acepta una expresión Python proporcionada por el usuario mediante la opción --filter. Esta entrada se pasa directamente a la función eval() sin saneamiento, lo que permite a un usuario local crear y ejecutar código arbitrario.

ZoneMinder versions 1.37.0 before 1.38.0 contain a path traversal vulnerability in the files view that allows authenticated users to read arbitrary files. The path parameter is not properly validated before being passed to output_file, enabling attackers with Events view permission to access sensitive files like configuration files containing database credentials.

Las versiones 1.37.0 anteriores a la 1.38.0 de ZoneMinder contienen una vulnerabilidad de salto de ruta en la vista de archivos que permite a usuarios autenticados leer archivos arbitrarios. El parámetro path no se valida correctamente antes de ser pasado a output_file, lo que permite a atacantes con permiso de vista de Eventos acceder a archivos sensibles, como archivos de configuración que contienen credenciales de base de datos.

virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated virtual python environments. Prior to 21.7.13, the generated activate (bash and zsh) and activate.fish scripts place values already escaped by shlex.quote inside an additional quoted context. In the bash and zsh script, a crafted virtual environment path reaches __VIRTUAL_ENV__ when a relocated environment's recorded directory is absent; in the fish script, crafted Tcl or Tk library paths reach __TCL_LIBRARY__ or __TK_LIBRARY__. The surplus quotes can terminate the data-only quoted run and leave shell metacharacters parsed as commands when a user sources the activation script, allowing code execution with that user's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 21.7.13.

Deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in The Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki Wikibase extension allows Leverage Executable Code in Non-Executable Files.

This issue affects MediaWiki Wikibase extension: 1.46, 1.45, and 1.43.

External control of system or configuration setting vulnerability in The Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki CentralAuth extension allows Code Injection.

This issue affects MediaWiki CentralAuth extension: 1.46, 1.45, and 1.43.

Algorithm::AhoCorasick::XS versions through 0.04 for Perl read the haystack string length before the scalar is stringified.

The matches, first_match and match_details methods use the T_STD_STRING typemap to translate Perl scalars (SVs) into strings via the std::string constructor, using the SvPV macro to stringify the haystack input, and the SvCUR macro to determine the length of the SV.

When the input SVs are references, integers (IVs) or floats (NVs), the SvCUR macro will return an invalid length if it is run before the input is stringified, leading to an out-of-bounds read which can abort the process.

Note that the evaluation order of arguments to std::string is unspecified. Depending on the compiler, SvCUR may be run first and lead to an abort that cannot be caught within Perl.

This can be triggered when the haystack is a numeric value, for example,

    my $ac = Algorithm::AhoCorasick::XS->new( [ "11", "22" ] );
    $ac->matches( 211 );

This can occur when the haystack is the result of reading data from decoded JSON or a numeric database column. It can also be triggered when using a blessed object as a haystack.

A remote, unauthenticated TLS client can make a server crash or call
through a freed pointer if its sni_callback assigns a different context to
SSLSocket.context (the documented way to select a certificate per server
name) and nothing else keeps the original ssl.SSLContext alive. Typical
cases are servers that create an SSLContext per connection or replace it
while connections are open; servers that wrap their listening socket with
it are not affected.


Mitigation: keep a reference to every SSLContext that sets sni_callback for
the lifetime of the server. TLS clients are not affected.

Inspur Haiyue HCM Cloud contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability in the /api/model_report/file/download endpoint that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read arbitrary files by supplying unvalidated path parameters index and ext. Attackers can craft requests such as /api/model_report/file/download?index=/&ext=<path> to traverse the filesystem and disclose sensitive files including /etc/passwd, application database files, and system configuration files. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-11-04 .

Inspur Haiyue HCM Cloud contiene una vulnerabilidad de lectura arbitraria de archivos en el endpoint /api/model_report/file/download que permite a atacantes remotos no autenticados leer archivos arbitrarios al proporcionar los parámetros de ruta no validados?index y?ext. Los atacantes pueden crear solicitudes como /api/model_report/file/download?index=/&ext=[path] para recorrer el sistema de archivos y revelar archivos sensibles, incluidos /etc/p4ssd, archivos de base de datos de la aplicación y archivos de configuración del sistema. La evidencia de explotación se observó por primera vez por la Shadowserver Foundation el 2024-11-04.

iControl is affected by an Improper Error Handling vulnerability, which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to trigger verbose database and system errors, enabling the disclosure of sensitive internal infrastructure details used to plan advanced targeted attacks.

iControl is affected by a Missing Secure Attribute vulnerability, which could allow an attacker to intercept cookies transmitted over unencrypted HTTP connections, enabling the unauthorized extraction of sensitive information such as session identifiers.

iControl is affected by a Session Timeout vulnerability, which could allow an attacker to exploit an unattended or abandoned active session, enabling unauthorized access to the application and the ability to perform actions on behalf of the victim.
Rejected reason: This CVE ID has been rejected or withdrawn by its CVE Numbering Authority. CVE-2024-33605's description was updated to include the impacted endpoint as singular patch addressed both.

A flaw was found in Foreman. The foreman-tail utility is vulnerable to OS command injection due to the unsafe use of the eval command. The script takes user-supplied arguments and incorporates them directly into a string that is then executed by eval to expand file paths. Because the input is not sanitized or quoted, a local attacker can inject shell metacharacters (e.g., ;, &, |) to execute arbitrary system commands.

In returnOutputBufferLocked of DeprecatedCamera3StreamSplitter.cpp, there is a possible out-of-bounds read due to a missing bounds check. This could lead to local information disclosure with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In handle_app_val_response of btif_rc.cc, there is a possible way to achieve code execution due to a race condition. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

Telegram Desktop before 7.2.9 contains an IPC record-separator injection vulnerability in Core::Sandbox that allows remote attackers to inject OPEN: records via crafted tg:// links containing unescaped semicolons. Attackers can reach the interpret: scheme handler to upload local files, including tdata session keys, to an attacker channel, enabling account takeover.

The WSO2 Identity Server fails to enforce a default expiry time for SMS One-Time Passwords (OTPs) used in multi-factor authentication (MFA). This allows unused OTPs to remain valid indefinitely, presenting an opportunity for malicious actors to conduct brute force attacks by repeatedly guessing the OTP.

The absence of automatic expiration for OTPs grants attackers an unlimited timeframe to attempt guessing the correct code. A successful brute force attack can lead to an MFA bypass, resulting in the unauthorized takeover of a user's account and compromising the security and privacy of both the individual and the system.

El WSO2 Identity Server no impone un tiempo de expiración predeterminado para los contraseñas de un solo uso (OTP) por SMS utilizados en la autenticación multifactor (MFA). Esto permite que los OTP no utilizados permanezcan válidos indefinidamente, ofreciendo a los actores maliciosos la oportunidad de realizar ataques de fuerza bruta adivinando repetidamente el OTP.\n\nLa ausencia de expiración automática de los OTP otorga a los atacantes un marco de tiempo ilimitado para intentar adivinar el código correcto. Un ataque de fuerza bruta exitoso puede conducir a eludir la MFA, lo que resulta en la toma no autorizada de la cuenta de un usuario y compromete la seguridad y privacidad tanto del individuo como del sistema.

Frappe before 14.58.0 and 15.x before 15.4.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in printview because printview parameters are not escaped before being rendered. Remote attackers can craft a malicious printview URL that, when visited by a victim, injects HTML and executes script in the victim's browser session.

Frappe antes de la versión 14.58.0 y 15.x antes de la versión 15.4.0 contiene una vulnerabilidad de Cross-site Scripting en printview porque los parámetros de printview no se escaparon antes de ser renderizados. Los atacantes remotos pueden crear una URL de printview maliciosa que, cuando es visitada por una víctima, inyecta HTML y ejecuta scripts en la sesión del navegador de la víctima.

Frappe Framework before 15.117.0 and 16.x before 16.30.0 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability in the handling of attributes in outgoing email HTML. Attackers who can supply outgoing email content can set an attribute value referencing a local file path to expose sensitive server files.

A flaw was found in BusyBox's udhcpc DHCP client. When processing raw DHCP packets, the client replaces the validated packet length with an attacker-controlled value from the IP header without re-validating the minimum size. This leads to an integer underflow when subtracting header sizes, causing a subsequent memory copy with a massively oversized length. An attacker on the same network segment can send a specially crafted packet to crash the DHCP client, resulting in denial of service and loss of network connectivity.

Adobe Commerce is affected by an Improper Input Validation vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. An attacker with high privileges could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

Bridge is affected by an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must open a malicious file.

An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to disclose sensitive information. Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must open a malicious file.

PhysicsFS through 3.2.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in __PHYSFS_utf8codepoint() that allows attackers to read past name buffers via an off-by-one cursor advance on six-octet UTF-8 sequences. Attackers can supply a crafted archive with entry names ending in six-octet sequences, causing PHYSFS_utf8stricmp() and hashing to over-read and crash the application.

PhysicsFS hasta la versión 3.2.0 incluida contiene una vulnerabilidad de lectura fuera de límites en __PHYSFS_utf8codepoint() que permite a los atacantes leer más allá de los buffers de nombres mediante un desplazamiento del cursor de un paso en secuencias UTF?8 de seis octetos. Los atacantes pueden proporcionar un archivo comprimido manipulado con nombres de entradas que terminen en secuencias de seis octetos, lo que hace que PHYSFS_utf8stricmp() y el proceso de hash lean más allá y provoquen el bloqueo de la aplicación.

MyReport Updater through 2.1.1 contains a local privilege escalation vulnerability that allows low-privileged users to make the SYSTEM updater service install attacker-supplied archives into arbitrary directories. Attackers can use UpdaterManager.exe over gRPC to set a malicious reference server and installLocation, planting a DLL like HID.dll loaded by osk.exe to gain SYSTEM privileges.

miniupnpc through 2.3.3 contains a one-byte heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the minixml parseelt function's namespace-prefix handling that skips an end-of-buffer check after advancing past ':'. A malicious or spoofed UPnP gateway on the local network can send a device description or SOAP reply ending in ':' within an element name to crash the client.

CGNS through 4.5.2 contains a stack out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ADFI_read_node_header that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying crafted ADF node headers. Attackers can craft .cgns or .adf files whose non-NUL-terminated end tag causes ADFI_stridx_c to scan past disk_node_data, crashing tools like cgnslist.

unshield through 1.6.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in unshield_get_file_table() that allows attackers to read past heap allocations via unchecked cabinet header offsets. Attackers can supply a crafted InstallShield cabinet with out-of-range file_table_offset or large file counts to crash the unshield tool or library consumers.
A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. Memory size is not adequately validated before mmap during vhost memory-region setup, which can lead to a host crash or memory corruption.

A flaw was found in the DPDK vhost library. When handling a virtio indirect descriptor table, the host reads the table length more than once from guest memory and can allocate a host copy before validating that length. A guest that changes the length between those reads, or that supplies an out-of-range next index on a small host copy in the vDPA relay path, can cause the host vhost process to walk past the validated mapping or heap copy. That can crash or disrupt the vhost process. Out-of-bounds bytes are consumed as descriptor fields for GPA translation and are not returned to the guest as payload. This is a residual issue in the non-contiguous indirect descriptor copy path introduced as part of the CVE-2018-1059 fix.

A flaw was found in the DPDK GSO library. When software GSO copies packet headers into a new mbuf, it does not check that the header fits in the source first segment or in the destination buffer, and a header longer than the configured GSO segment size can underflow the payload-size calculation. A remote or guest-supplied packet processed with software GSO can trigger an out-of-bounds read or write.
A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. A TOCTOU double-fetch of control-queue descriptors allows a heap buffer overflow with attacker-controlled content in the VDUSE control-queue handler.
A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. A double-offset bug in vhost log mapping calculation can lead to incorrect memory access.
A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. A guest can desynchronize virtqueue size from inflight descriptor table size, causing an out-of-bounds write in the host vhost process.
A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. A guest with runt RX descriptors can underflow the copy length in vhost enqueue, causing a denial of service in a shared vhost backend such as OVS-DPDK.
A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. The VDUSE handler fails to invalidate vring pointers when the IOTLB is invalidated, leading to use-after-unmap.

A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. Session cleanup can leave a stale cached session pointer, and the data path does not check the session type before attaching it, leading to use-after-free or type confusion in the host vhost-crypto backend.

A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. A guest can supply an avail-ring descriptor index that is used without bounds checking, causing an out-of-bounds write in the host vhost-crypto backend.

A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. Write-back chain cleanup can follow an uninitialized next pointer when mapping a guest descriptor fails, causing the host vhost-crypto process to hang or crash.

A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. The indirect-descriptor snapshot double-fetches a guest descriptor next index, allowing a malicious guest to cause an out-of-bounds access in the host backend.
A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. Integer overflow in chain length checks, and missing length checks on the RSA path, can overflow a host buffer in the vhost-crypto backend.
A flaw was found in the DPDK nfp vDPA driver. Stack and heap buffers sized for a single queue pair can be overflowed when more virtqueues are configured, leading to a host crash or memory corruption.

FlexPrice through 2.1.38 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in HandleQuickBooksWebhook that skips signature verification when the intuit-signature header is omitted. Unauthenticated attackers knowing a tenant and environment ID can replay forged payment notifications to repeatedly add payment amounts, marking invoices paid or overpaid.

Databasus 3.7.0 through 3.61.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to brute-force password reset codes via POST /api/v1/users/reset-password. Attackers can request a six-digit code for a known email, then guess it without rate limiting, lockout, or invalidation to take over accounts, including administrators.

A security vulnerability has been detected in cemtan sar2html 4.0.0. This affects the function deleteHost/deleteRange/deleteAll of the file sar2html.py. Such manipulation leads to missing authentication. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

When the PCM sample array needs to grow, the RACK stack doubles a 16-bit allocation counter.  Repeated doublings caused the counter to wrap to zero, resulting in a near-zero-length allocation followed by a copy of the existing samples into the undersized buffer.  A remote peer can trigger the expansion by sending a sufficient number of ACKs on an established connection.

A remote attacker who can establish a TCP connection to a system using the RACK stack can trigger an out-of-bounds write of approximately 512 KB in the kernel heap possibly resulting in a kernel panic.

Jpom through 2.11.12 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in SshFileController that allows authenticated workspace users to access SSH hosts belonging to other workspaces by supplying foreign SSH asset ids. Attackers with SSH file permissions in any workspace can call download, upload, read_file_data.json, update_file_data.json, delete.json, rename.json and new_file_folder.json endpoints to read, modify and delete files on other workspaces' SSH hosts.

Coder 2.3.1 before 2.14.4, 2.15.x before 2.15.3, and 2.16.0 before 2.16.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the login page because the redirect query parameter is improperly sanitized. Attackers can craft a Coder login URL that, when clicked by a logged-in user, redirects the victim to an attacker-controlled website for phishing.

Coder 2.3.1, versiones anteriores a 2.14.4; 2.15.x, versiones anteriores a 2.15.3; y 2.16.0, versiones anteriores a 2.16.1, contiene una vulnerabilidad de redirección abierta en la página de inicio de sesión porque el parámetro de consulta redirect no se depura correctamente. Los atacantes pueden crear una URL de inicio de sesión de Coder que, al ser pulsada por un usuario autenticado, redirige a la víctima a un sitio web controlado por el atacante para phishing.

The RemoteUserStoreManagerService does not sufficiently validate password change attempts when the password history validation feature is enabled. This oversight allows an attacker to repeatedly attempt password guesses for a user account without being adequately restricted.

Exploiting this vulnerability enables an attacker to discover a user's password through brute force, leading to account impersonation. The success rate of such an attack is influenced by the complexity of the targeted user's password, with simpler passwords increasing the likelihood of compromise.

El RemoteUserStoreManagerService no valida de forma suficiente los intentos de cambio de contraseña cuando la funcionalidad de validación del historial de contraseñas está habilitada. Esta omisión permite a un atacante intentar repetidamente adivinar la contraseña de una cuenta de usuario sin estar adecuadamente restringido.\n\nExplotar esta vulnerabilidad permite a un atacante descubrir la contraseña de un usuario mediante fuerza bruta, lo que lleva a la suplantación de la cuenta. La tasa de éxito de dicho ataque está influenciada por la complejidad de la contraseña del usuario objetivo, y las contraseñas más simples aumentan la probabilidad de compromiso.

A missing critical step in authentication vulnerability in Apache Tomcat when the JNDI realm was configured with with a non GSSAPI SASL authentication mechanism allowed attackers to authenticate without providing the correct password.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M1 through 11.0.26, from 10.1.0-M1 through 10.1.60, from 9.0.0.M1 through 9.0.122.



The following versions were EOL at the time the CVE was created but are known to be affected: from 8.5.0 through 8.5.100, from 7.0.0 through 7.0.109. Other unsupported versions may also be affected.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.27, 10.1.61 or 9.0.123, which fix the issue.

A flaw was found in GNU patch. An attacker can achieve arbitrary file creation outside the intended working directory by enticing a user or automated workflow to apply a specially crafted patch file. A flaw was found in openshift-ansible. The installer container's `run` script downloads and executes remote inventory and dynamic scripts without integrity verification. VoiceSentinel is a real-time voice moderation system for Minecraft servers. From 2.2.1 until 3.3.1, the optional report buffer feature has a race between retention cleanup and normal transcript writes. In `report_buffer.py`, `_maybe_cleanup()` uses an unlocked dictionary for once-per-hour cleanup throttling, allowing simultaneous `_cleanup_tenant()` operations for one tenant. Cleanup reads `transcripts.jsonl` and rewrites it in place without file locking or atomic replacement, while `report_buffer_append_async` uses `asyncio.to_thread` to append without synchronization. In `main.py`, concurrent `_processing_worker` tasks make this reachable in normal operation; `processing.worker_count` of two or more and public-pool servers sharing a `server_key` increase collisions. With `report_buffer.enabled` set to true, racing writes can lose, duplicate or corrupt transcript data and defeat `report_buffer.retention_seconds` pruning, allowing unbounded disk growth that can exhaust storage and crash the host or other services sharing it. The feature is opt-in and disabled by default. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.1.

In server mode pgAdmin 4 locks an internal account after MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS failed logins (3 by default). The limit could be bypassed, giving an unauthenticated attacker an unlimited number of password guesses against any internal account, including the administrator's, in the default configuration:

- Flask-Security registers its own views next to pgAdmin's. A login submitted to its /login view was checked and logged in without pgAdmin's failed login count or lock. Its /verify view checked a signed-in user's password without limit, its /change view changed a password without pgAdmin's change password permission or re-encrypting the user's saved server passwords, and its /reset views sent and applied password resets for accounts that are not internal or are locked.
- The internal account was looked up by its exact username, while the login form matches the email ignoring case, so a login with the username typed in another case was neither counted nor checked for the lock.
- With LDAP or webserver authentication also configured, a wrong internal password was never counted, and with Kerberos or webserver authentication configured a guess could be answered without being counted.

In addition, where accounts from different authentication sources share an email address, a password reset could be sent for, or applied to, an account from another source, and the About box showed the server configuration to a user whose email was that of an administrator's account.

The fix refuses submissions to Flask-Security's own views, counts every failed internal login however the username is typed and whatever other sources are configured, no longer lets a login that posts a password fall back to an authentication source that does not check it, and locks only internal authentication. Password resets and the About box act only on the user's own internal account. Desktop mode is not affected.

This issue affects pgAdmin 4: before 9.19.

In pgAdmin 4 server mode only administrators are meant to share a server with all users; the server dialog shows the Shared switch only to them. The create and update endpoints of the server API, however, stored the "shared" flag and shared username they were sent, so any user able to register a server could share one with every other user. The servers.json import had a similar gap: a non-administrator's "Shared" entries were removed only after validation, so a file that also held an invalid entry could create a shared server.

A shared server carries no credentials, so this gives no direct access. It lets a user plant a server, named to look trusted, in every other user's tree and pointing at a host the user controls; anyone who then connects to it presents their own database password to that host.

The fix refuses a non-administrator's request that would share a server with HTTP 403, prunes a non-administrator's shared entries from a servers.json import before validating it, and warns at startup about servers shared earlier by non-administrators.

This issue affects pgAdmin 4: before 9.19.

In server mode pgAdmin 4 resolves a server's password file, SSL certificate, key, CRL and SSH tunnel identity file relative to the user's storage directory, but get_complete_file_path() only stripped leading slashes before joining the two. A path such as "../<another user>/.pgpass", set through the server dialog, the REST API or a servers.json import, therefore named another user's file, and connecting used that user's saved passwords, client certificate or SSH key. The sslkeylogfile connection parameter was passed to libpq unchanged, so a path outside storage let libpq create or append a file as the account running pgAdmin.

make_conninfo() also quoted connection parameter values but not their names, so a crafted parameter name could smuggle additional keyword=value pairs past these checks.

The fix requires the resolved path, with symbolic links followed, to stay inside the user's storage directory or the named shared storage directory, confines sslkeylogfile the same way, and accepts only exact libpq keywords as connection parameter names. A refused path or keyword is reported instead of letting libpq fall back to a default.

This issue affects pgAdmin 4: before 9.19.

In server mode pgAdmin 4 validates a path a user gives for a file in their storage directory with check_access_permission() and then opened it by name. Several places opened it with a plain open() or handed the path to a utility that opened it later: the servers.json export and import and the import file listing, and the files given to pg_dump, pg_dumpall, pg_restore and psql by Backup, Restore and Import/Export Data. A symbolic link swapped in at the file or at any parent directory between the check and the open redirected the operation outside the storage directory, so a file could be written, overwritten or read, or loaded into a table, as the operating-system account running pgAdmin. A hard link to an outside file, which O_NOFOLLOW does not detect, and a FIFO, which could hang a request, had the same effect. CVE-2026-86861 fixed this for the File Manager's save_file; these were the remaining paths.

Exploitation requires creating such a link or FIFO inside the user's storage directory. pgAdmin offers no way to do so, and the per-user storage directories belong to the pgAdmin account, so this requires write access to the storage backend as a different operating-system user, for example a shared or network-mounted storage directory, and winning the race.

The fix opens each file by walking down from the storage directory one component at a time with O_NOFOLLOW, accepting only a regular file with one link, and passes the utilities the open descriptor (/dev/fd/N) on Linux. Error messages no longer include the server path.

This issue affects pgAdmin 4: before 9.19.

Jpom 2.10.0 through 2.11.12 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain super-administrator access by injecting query conditions into the JPOM-USER-TOKEN header. Attackers can send a value like 'is not null', which Hutool's Condition parser treats as an operator, then execute commands through Jpom's script features.

XS::libbrotli versions before 1.2.1.0 for Perl bundle a brotli library with an out-of-bounds write in the decoder.

Affected versions compile a bundled brotli into static archives that dependent XS modules link against at build time, rather than using the system library. The bundled copy, 1.0.7 or 1.1.0 across the range, carries the decoder out-of-bounds write described in CVE-2026-111497. Version 1.2.1.0 updates it to brotli 1.2.1.

XS::libbrotli has no Perl interface, so the decoder is reached through any dependent module that decompresses untrusted data with it. An attacker supplying a crafted brotli stream can corrupt decoder state, disclose memory, crash the process, or potentially execute arbitrary code. Upgrading the system brotli does not remediate this.

When parsing an uploaded Helm chart, Gitea decompressed the archive and read every tar entry while looking for `Chart.yaml` without limiting the decompressed size, and did so before the package size quota was checked; the quota only considers the compressed upload size. A user with package write access to an owner, for example their own account on an instance with open registration, could repeatedly upload small, highly compressed archives that make the server spend CPU time proportional to the decompressed size, degrading the availability of the Gitea instance. The issue does not allow code execution or data access.

HTTP::Session versions before 0.54 for Perl allow memcached command injection via unfiltered session ids in HTTP::Session::Store::CHI.

The session id from the client's cookie reaches the CHI cache unchanged. The sibling HTTP::Session::Store::Memcached rejects ids that contain control characters, but the CHI store has no such check, and CHI does not escape keys for its memcached drivers.

With a memcached driver, a CR and LF in the session id end the cache command early, and the server reads the bytes after them as further commands.

The account lock feature fails to correctly enforce account lockouts on the primary user store when users with identical usernames exist in both primary and secondary user stores. This occurs because the lock condition is only applied to the secondary user store account in such scenarios, allowing continued authentication attempts against the primary user store account.

This functional flaw enables brute force attacks. By systematically attempting different passwords against the primary user store account, an attacker can potentially gain unauthorized access to sensitive information or accounts, as the intended account lockout mechanism does not prevent repeated login attempts.

La función de bloqueo de cuentas no aplica correctamente los bloqueos de cuentas en el almacén de usuarios principal cuando existen usuarios con nombres de usuario idénticos tanto en el almacén de usuarios principal como en el secundario. Esto ocurre porque la condición de bloqueo solo se aplica a la cuenta del almacén de usuarios secundario en tales escenarios, lo que permite intentos de autenticación continuos contra la cuenta del almacén de usuarios principal.

Este fallo funcional permite ataques de fuerza bruta. Al intentar sistemáticamente diferentes contraseñas contra la cuenta del almacén de usuarios principal, un atacante puede obtener potencialmente acceso no autorizado a información o cuentas sensibles, ya que el mecanismo de bloqueo de cuentas previsto no impide los intentos de inicio de sesión repetidos.

The user search function within the management console fails to properly encode user-supplied input before rendering it in the browser. This allows an attacker to inject malicious scripts that are then executed by the user's browser in the context of the management console.

Successful exploitation enables an attacker to redirect the user's browser to a malicious website, modify the web page's user interface, or extract information from the browser. However, due to the use of the httpOnly flag on sensitive session cookies, session hijacking or similar attacks are prevented.

La función de búsqueda de usuarios dentro de la consola de administración no codifica correctamente la entrada proporcionada por el usuario antes de renderizarla en el navegador. Esto permite a un atacante inyectar scripts maliciosos que luego son ejecutados por el navegador del usuario en el contexto de la consola de administración.

La explotación exitosa permite a un atacante redirigir el navegador del usuario a un sitio web malicioso, modificar la interfaz de usuario de la página web o extraer información del navegador. Sin embargo, debido al uso de la bandera httpOnly en las cookies de sesión sensibles, se evitan el secuestro de sesión o ataques similares.

The affected components accept user-supplied input for constructing redirection URLs without enforcing expected validation constraints. This allows an attacker to provide a crafted URL that can redirect users to an arbitrary external domain.

By leveraging this open redirection vulnerability, an attacker can craft a malicious link that, when clicked by a user, redirects them to an attacker-controlled page. This can be used in conjunction with social engineering techniques to execute phishing attacks, aiming to obtain sensitive information or cause other harm.

Los componentes afectados aceptan entradas proporcionadas por el usuario para construir URL de redirección sin aplicar las restricciones de validación esperadas. Esto permite a un atacante proporcionar una URL manipulada que puede redirigir a los usuarios a un dominio externo arbitrario.

Al aprovechar esta vulnerabilidad de redirección abierta, un atacante puede crear un enlace malicioso que, al ser pulsado por un usuario, los redirige a una página controlada por el atacante. Esto puede utilizarse en combinación con técnicas de ingeniería social para ejecutar ataques de phishing, con el objetivo de obtener información sensible o causar otros daños.

affectedData.product: WSO2 Identity Server as Key Manager

descriptions.value:
The refresh token grant type in WSO2 products fails to re-validate account status before issuing new access tokens. This weakness allows an attacker to obtain valid access tokens for user accounts even after they have been blocked by the user store, bypassing account lockout mechanisms.

This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to user accounts and their associated resources. Attackers can leverage this to perform actions on behalf of blocked users, potentially leading to privilege escalation or data exfiltration depending on the permissions of the compromised account.

El tipo de concesión de token de actualización en los productos WSO2 no revalida el estado de la cuenta antes de emitir nuevos tokens de acceso. Esta vulnerabilidad permite a un atacante obtener tokens de acceso válidos para cuentas de usuario incluso después de que hayan sido bloqueadas por el almacén de usuarios, eludiendo los mecanismos de bloqueo de cuentas.

Esta vulnerabilidad puede conducir a un acceso no autorizado a las cuentas de usuario y sus recursos asociados. Los atacantes pueden aprovechar esto para realizar acciones en nombre de usuarios bloqueados, lo que podría conducir a una escalada de privilegios o a la exfiltración de datos, dependiendo de los permisos de la cuenta comprometida.
